effects.label: Desert protection
effects.description: Consumes 1 charge at end of turn in desert to prevent hostile environment damage.

effects.label: Water recharge
effects.description: Recharges 1 charge at end of turn in water.

effects.label: Desert Immunity
effects.description: Prevents hostile environment damage in the desert while held.

effects.label: Strength Boost
effects.description: Increase your Strength by 2 for the current turn.

effects.label: Helmet Protection
effects.description: Fortune check 80+: reduce incoming non-magic combat damage by 1.

effects.label: Shield Protection
effects.description: Fortune check 65+: reduce incoming non-magic combat damage by 1.

effects.label: Armour Protection
effects.description: Fortune check 50+: reduce incoming non-magic combat damage by 1.

effects.label: Dragon Slayer
effects.description: Grants +3 Strength when fighting Dragon enemies.

effects.label: Magic Wand Refill
effects.description: Draw a new spell from the spell deck when your spellbook becomes empty.

effects.label: Fortune Pendant
effects.description: Apply the Fortune status for 1 turn on a successful luck check.

effects.label: Talisman Ward
effects.description: Silences the holder (cannot cast spells) but grants immunity to other players' spells.

effects.label: Exorcise Spirit
effects.description: Destroy a spirit enemy without combat and gain 1 experience.

effects.label: Crystal Ball Skip
effects.description: Once per turn, discard one exploration card and draw a replacement.

effects.label: Region III Access
effects.description: Required to enter Region III and avoid its lethal environment.
